original_test_intent: Verify the physically connected SUT serial port and client form a stable bidirectional communication channel at the approved serial settings, with correct benign payload/response and no corruption, framing or timeout errors.
original_method: A trained operator identifies/connects both physical endpoints using the approved cable/pinout, configures matching serial parameters, establishes exclusive session ownership, transmits a predetermined harmless challenge in each required direction, records exact bytes/timestamps/responses/errors and closes/restores the path safely.
manual_activity: A trained operator connects/configures the serial endpoints, performs and observes the approved bidirectional exchange and confirms physical/session state; the owner adjudicates the captured result.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/client identities, serial ports, connector/pinout/electrical level and approved cable/adapter
Console ownership/exclusivity and safe power/ESD procedure
Harmless TX/RX payloads or commands for each direction and exact expected bytes/response/timing
safety_requirements: Verify connector/pinout/electrical levels and exclusive ownership before connection
Use only predetermined non-destructive payloads/commands with no credentials/secrets
Preserve logs; never clear evidence or use a state-changing action as a connectivity probe
Stop on wrong target, electrical/adapter fault, garbled/unexpected output, one-way path or repeated timeout
Close/release terminal ownership and restore the approved physical cable state
agent_execution_scope: After operator connection, assist with capture timestamps, byte/response comparison, redaction and artifact hashing
Calculate observed direction/timing/error results against supplied contract
Keep functional communication evidence separate from mechanical-fit and console-setup rows
Perform no wiring, terminal ownership or unapproved command transmission
Make no hardware verdict without operator/owner confirmation
engineer_actions: Provide exact serial configuration and benign bidirectional payload/response contract
Supervise physical path/session and resolve any corruption/one-way/timeout issue
Review raw capture/photos/logs and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can establish or observe the physical serial cable/client path; its manual assessment is correct. Exact terminal commands depend on the owner-supplied safe payload contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator uses the approved terminal tools on both physical endpoints to send finite known payloads/benign commands in required directions and records raw TX/RX/errors with synchronized timestamps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical cable, client connection, useful-command communication objective and 5/5-minute estimates remain; typographical errors do not alter intended two-way function.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH MANUAL BIDIRECTIONAL SERIAL COMMUNICATION TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a challenge-response matrix with direction, exact bytes, sequence/timestamp, timeout, response and framing/parity/overrun/error flags plus labeled physical-path photos and final ownership release.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines normal communication objectively and safely while preserving physical setup and logs.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A visible prompt or one successful command can prove only one direction/path segment; the source's communication objective needs explicit bidirectional evidence and error-free transport.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Serial channels can appear readable despite mismatched flow control/encoding or intermittent wiring. Physical observation and raw capture across both directions are essential.

project_override_considerations: If the console protocol is inherently request/response in one initiated direction, the owner can define how the reply proves the reverse path; this mapping must be explicit rather than assuming separate arbitrary commands.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/client/port/cable/adapter identities
Pinout/electrical/safe-state plus complete terminal parameter and ownership record
Labeled connection photos and timestamped raw challenge/response TX/RX capture
Exact expected-versus-observed bytes/prompts/timing and framing/parity/timeout/error report
Preserved logs, safe session close/final cable state and operator/owner verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, physical cable procedure and normal-communication Criteria are coherent. The missing exact parameters/payload define project execution inputs rather than contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Physical access and owner communication contract gate execution but the full static review is complete.

review_improvement: Turns subjective 'works normally' into a safe, exact bidirectional byte/response and error contract while respecting the non-automatable physical boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: A serial link comprises physical wiring, framing/flow settings and two directions; verifying only a prompt or outbound echo can leave the reverse data path or hardware handshake untested. A known finite challenge-response exposes corruption, wrong settings and timeout behavior without granting arbitrary console control. Since automation cannot see the actual cable endpoints, target identity and physical photos remain operator evidence, while transcript comparison is a safe assistive task.
